title: Is Investor Attention for Sale? The Role of Advertising in Financial Markets

scopes.description: Complete supplied author workflow: SAS daily-panel preparation and table branches, followed by Stata attention, timing, robustness, liquidity, and return analyses.

requirements.description: Author-created daily date grid print.dates, created in Excel then imported in SAS; must cover the observed advertising panel dates.
Matched-company lookup print.list5 used to link company_num to lpermno and carry firm identifiers such as gvkey/companyname; retains the supplied exclusions.

Media Radar daily advertisement table print.ads4 joined on company_num/date with daily=1 and nonmissing lpermno; the code uses publication_num, est_value2, business, national, new_brand and large_ad among its measures.

routes.description: Historical purchase is documented, but present entitlement, prepared file delivery, exact schema and panel coverage are unverified.

requirements.description: Circulation input carried with the ad rows, including sun_sat; SAS assigns weekend circ from sun_sat and aggregates circ by lpermno/date.

routes.location: Author-prepared print.ads4 circulation fields / AAM-derived circulation
routes.description: AAM access is historical; the current circulation product, rights, field schema and date/company coverage are unverified.

requirements.description: Prepared matched RavenPack table print.rp_news joined by lpermno/date, with group, relevance, rp_story_id and category; SAS filters stock-prices/order-imbalances and relevance=100.

routes.description: Frozen catalog lists candidate raw story and mapping products. Both bounded probes timed out. These candidates do not establish prepared print.rp_news compatibility, mapping to lpermno, field definitions, coverage, or current entitlement.

requirements.description: CRSP holiday dates in crsp.holidays, joined to the daily panel to create holiday.
CRSP identifier crosswalk crsp.companies used to add permco and cusip from permno; preserve the supplied manual corrections to selected permnos.
Prepared Thomson ownership interval panel thomson.f13_2007_20132 with cusip, date, lag_date and inst_inv_share, joined as date <= panel date < lag_date.

routes.description: Local raw 13F source is only a candidate for regenerating the interval panel; the exact local path and compatibility with f13_2007_20132 are not verified, and its bounded probe timed out.

requirements.description: Google ticker-query panel go.daily_svi4 with permco/date/svi_d_scaled, returns_box, any_flag and ticker; used for lnsvi, ticker_flag, returns_box and ticker.
Separate Google full-name query panel go.daily_fullnames2 with permco/date/svi_d_scaled; used for lnsvi_name.
SEC downloads_master access-count panel with gvkey/date and annual, all, fundamental counts; joined to construct the three log-hit controls.
Separate edgar_8k_10k_10q_filing input with gvkey and file_date; SAS normalizes gvkey and joins filing dates to the daily panel.

routes.description: Exact documented corpus directories exist, but only directory presence was checked. They are candidate filing-text corpora, not verified filing-date tables; no recursive discovery, schema, CIK/GVKEY crosswalk or coverage check was done.

requirements.description: Preprocessed dis.comp_full_sample quarterly earnings-announcement panel. Code filters year 2006–2014, matches eadate_crsp to eadate_ibes, keeps shrcd 10/11, then joins permno/eadate_crsp to the daily panel to form qea_dummy.
Annual comp.funda_2013 fundamentals joined by gvkey for datadate in [one year before daily date, daily date); used for prcc_f, csho, ib, at, lt, ceq, revt, ni, xad and sich.

routes.description: Bounded one-row read succeeded and exposed the required candidate source columns. This is an unverified candidate for author comp.funda_2013 because vintage, sample/date coverage and any author preprocessing are not established.

requirements.description: Prepared print.ret_volatility table with permno/date and return-volatility fields consumed by Stata: abret_mkt, abret_mkt_0_3 and volatility_abret_mkt.
Prepared CRSP crsp.dsf_index_2013 daily panel with permno/date, shrout, vol, prc, prc_lag, size and bm.

routes.description: Bounded one-row read succeeded for raw CRSP.DSF fields. It does not establish the author-derived dsf_index_2013 table or its prc_lag/size/bm construction, exact vintage or coverage.

requirements.description: Prepared taq.mr_taq daily panel joined by permno/date, with dollar_depth, effectivespread_percent_sw, quotedspread_percent and turn.

issues.description: Stata explicitly merges FF3F_abnormal_ret.dta, but no producer for that independent file is supplied. Preserve this input separately from SAS print.ret_volatility; the exact overlapping/nonconflicting return fields and producer are unknown.

The supplied package does not include macro definitions or document the industry-category/output semantics for %ind_ff48 and %ind_ff12. A documented compatible provider could satisfy the calls; the exact mapping/version semantics remain unresolved. Required outputs are bin_var, ind_code and ind_code12.

The Stata program uses legacy reghdfe IV syntax, stages(ols), e(cdf), e(jp) and estimates restore reghdfe_ols. The installed reghdfe 6.12.3 command is present, but official pinned source documents the IV/2SLS move, and its current syntax is not a demonstrated match for these calls. Exact compatible author-era command/version, diagnostics and saved estimate naming remain unresolved; do not substitute an estimator automatically.

The distinct mn.ads4_JAR sharing extract appears before the supplied same-file mn.day1 producer. This is a routine ordering preparation: schedule the extract after the producer and preserve its selected fields/filter; it does not indicate failure of the main daily-panel workflow.

The supplied SAS librefs/SASAUTOS and Stata working directory use machine-specific Windows paths. Configure every affected producer and consumer cohesively for the current workspace and preserve the generated DTA handoff.

evidence.description: The SAS 9.4 PC Files guide limits the unlicensed local Import/Export set to JMP and delimited formats; Stata export capability must be verified.
evidence.quote: available only to JMP 7 or later files and delimited files

actions.description: Provide the compatible Excel-derived print.dates and matched print.list5 lookup, or document the exact author recipe that creates them.
steps: Use prepared print.dates to bypass Excel creation when available; otherwise retain Excel as the documented manual stage.
Confirm the date range and the print.list5 fields used by the join, including company_num and lpermno and identifiers consumed later.
Preserve the supplied Media-company exclusions and nonmissing lpermno restriction.
validation: Check dates are unique at daily level and cover the observed ad panel.
Check matched company_num/lpermno links are nonmissing without inventing a new crosswalk.

actions.description: Confirm current entitlement or obtain the author-prepared Media Radar advertisement and circulation rows required by print.ads4.
steps: Confirm current delivery/rights for the historical Media Radar and AAM-derived materials; the 2013–2014 dates alone do not establish them.
Supply join/filter fields company_num, date, daily and lpermno, plus publication_num, est_value2, business, national, new_brand and large_ad.
Confirm the circulation source and sun_sat field required for weekend circ before using the supplied aggregation.
validation: Check company/date coverage and field definitions against the exact SAS joins and filters.
Check weekend circ uses sun_sat as written and aggregates at lpermno/date.

actions.description: Supply matched RavenPack print.rp_news or a documented compatible preparation from local story and entity-mapping products.
steps: Confirm current entitlement or provide the historical prepared matched table; the timed-out bounded probes are inconclusive.
If evaluating RPA.RP_EQUITIES_2014 and RPA.RP_ENTITY_MAPPING together, establish date/category/relevance fields and entity-to-lpermno mapping.
Preserve stock-prices/order-imbalances filters, relevance=100, story identifiers, category handling and the lpermno/date join.
validation: Check field definitions and date/firm coverage against the supplied SAS where clause and joins before selecting a route.

actions.description: Provide or verify the exact CRSP holiday and permno identifier-crosswalk tables used by SAS preparation.
steps: Resolve the exact local catalog product or access route for crsp.holidays and crsp.companies; readable CRSP.DSF is not proof of either.
Preserve supplied manual permno corrections after linking permno to permco and cusip.
validation: Check holiday date coverage and key uniqueness/coverage of the required permno-to-permco/cusip mapping.

actions.description: Provide the author-prepared Thomson f13_2007_20132 interval panel or confirm a compatible local 13F preparation route.
steps: Confirm current access or deliver cusip, date, lag_date and inst_inv_share.
If evaluating the TFN.S34 candidate, verify the exact source and recipe required for the interval panel; the timeout is inconclusive.
Preserve the half-open as-of interval date <= panel date < lag_date.
validation: Check CUSIP format, interval boundaries, date coverage and multiple-match behavior before joining.

actions.description: Supply both distinct historical Google scaled-query panels used by the code.
steps: Supply daily_svi4 ticker-query rows with permco, date, svi_d_scaled, returns_box, any_flag and ticker.
Separately supply daily_fullnames2 full-name rows with permco, date and svi_d_scaled.
Confirm historical scaling and query/firm mapping; do not substitute an unrelated current search index.
validation: Check the two panels separately for keys, scale, date coverage and fields used to generate lnsvi, lnsvi_name, returns_box and ticker_flag.

actions.description: Provide the SEC downloads_master access-count panel or its documented producer.
steps: Obtain author-compatible daily gvkey/date counts annual, all and fundamental, or the producer and schema for those counts.
Keep SEC filing text and filing-date products separate from downloads_master access logs.
validation: Check count semantics, gvkey/date keys and author-required observation period before forming log-hit variables.

actions.description: Provide the exact SEC filing-date table or verify a bounded preparation route from already documented local filing corpora.
steps: Verify exact schema, coverage and gvkey-to-filing-identifier mapping against the existing documented directories using a bounded check; do not recursively discover files.
If compatible, prepare the author-required 8-K/10-K/10-Q table with gvkey and file_date; otherwise supply the prepared edgar_8k_10k_10q_filing input.
Preserve the source gvkey normalization and file_date join.
validation: Check form/date classification, identifier crosswalk and filing-date coverage against the supplied SAS logic.

actions.description: Supply the preprocessed quarterly earnings-announcement input dis.comp_full_sample or its author preparation specification.
steps: Provide fields used by the filter/join: year, eadate_crsp, eadate_ibes, shrcd, permno and retained earnings-surprise controls.
Preserve the 2006–2014 year filter, matched event dates and share codes 10/11; do not assume raw I/B/E/S files are compatible.
validation: Check event-date matches and firm/date coverage including the Stata qea_10 plus/minus five-day construction.

actions.description: Verify the local COMP.FUNDA candidate against the author comp.funda_2013 source and date convention.
steps: Treat the successful one-row probe as candidate readability and field evidence only; verify author-era vintage and historical/sample coverage.
Confirm the alias/selection producing comp.funda_2013 and retain datadate rather than substituting fyear.
Preserve the join interval from one year before daily date up to but not including daily date.
validation: Check required columns and exact historical coverage with a bounded table validation before full preparation.

actions.description: Provide the prepared print.ret_volatility table and its producer/variable definitions.
steps: Supply author-compatible permno/date rows and definitions for abret_mkt, abret_mkt_0_3 and volatility_abret_mkt.
Keep this SAS join distinct from FF3F_abnormal_ret.dta until field overlap and producer are confirmed.
validation: Check key uniqueness, field definitions and whether SAS-generated instrument_lag retains the variables under the names Stata reads.

actions.description: Verify local CRSP.DSF or provide the author-prepared crsp.dsf_index_2013 panel and exact derivation.
steps: Treat the bounded raw CRSP.DSF read as a candidate only; confirm date/security coverage and author vintage.
Obtain the recipe for prc_lag, size and bm and the expected shrout/vol/prc variables, or supply the prepared table; do not invent transformations.
validation: Check permno/date key compatibility, derived field definitions and date coverage before joining.

actions.description: Provide the prepared TAQ mr_taq daily liquidity panel or its compatible licensed source and author preparation.
steps: Confirm current access or supply daily permno/date fields with dollar_depth, effectivespread_percent_sw, quotedspread_percent and turn.
Document the TAQ product, unit/aggregation definitions and join fields; historical WRDS access does not establish current entitlement or prepared-table compatibility.
validation: Check field units, daily aggregation, identifier mapping and date coverage against the supplied join.

actions.description: Provide FF3F_abnormal_ret.dta and its separate producer/variable specification.
steps: Locate or obtain the exact Stata merge file and producer/version keyed by permno/date.
Confirm which nonconflicting return series it contributes, including ret used by business_d3, and which abnormal return fields instead come from print.ret_volatility/instrument_lag.
Keep the SAS handoff and FF3F merge as distinct inputs until exact overlap is documented.
validation: Check key uniqueness, variable collision behavior, return definitions and resulting names before analysis.

actions.description: Obtain or document compatible SAS autocall definitions and industry mapping that meet the supplied macro call and output contract.
steps: Locate supplied definitions or select a documented compatible provider implementing %ind_ff48 and %ind_ff12; byte-identical author originals are not required when the documented interface and category contract match.
Confirm accepted input table, sich variable, macro argument order, and outputs bin_var, ind_code and ind_code12 expected by later code.
Keep category and mapping semantics explicit; do not invent or silently substitute a crosswalk.
validation: Check the selected definitions accept the exact supplied macro call forms and output the required variables.
Check the documented industry categories align with downstream code and table labels.

actions.description: Resolve the exact legacy reghdfe IV/stages behavior required by the supplied Stata program before any author regression.
steps: Identify the author-era release or documented legacy invocation compatible with the parenthesized IV calls and stages(ols); command presence alone is insufficient.
Confirm documentation for e(cdf), e(jp) and saving the OLS stage as reghdfe_ols, as required by the source.
Do not replace the estimator or install a package automatically.
validation: Compare every IV/stages call and stored-result reference to the selected pinned command documentation before author execution.

actions.description: Schedule the separate ad-sharing extract after the supplied mn.day1 producer in the full workflow.
steps: For the supplied same-file run, place the mn.ads4_JAR block after the mn.day1 producer and its weekend circulation update.
Preserve the sharing block publication_num filter, selected fields and the main analysis/table branches.
A previously produced mn.day1 can remain a separate optional route only if its provenance and schema are later documented.
validation: Check the share extract reads the mn.day1 created in the same workflow and retains its documented keep-list/filter.
Check no main daily-panel or analysis branch is removed or redirected.

actions.description: Configure all SAS and Stata paths consistently for the current workspace and generated-file handoff.
steps: Set all SAS LIBNAME roots and SASAUTOS to available relative or [redacted-path-a86ec39c89f0] paths; do not edit only the first libref.
Set SAS output to Programs/instrument_lag.dta under a chosen project run root and set Stata working directory to that Programs directory.
Keep FF3F_abnormal_ret.dta explicit and separate until its producer/input is supplied.
validation: Review all affected SAS path assignments and Stata cd/read paths together.
After authorized preparation, confirm SAS output and Stata input resolve to the same file before starting Stata.

actions.description: Verify SAS 9.4 TS1M8 startup/configuration independently of author code.
steps: Confirm batch startup after the documented autoexec/work configuration; the current TKELS initialization failure leaves runtime unverified, not missing or unlicensed.
validation: Record the verified runtime version and environment-only startup result.

actions.description: Verify local SAS-to-Stata DTA export capability used by the supplied producer.
steps: Confirm deployment metadata for SAS/ACCESS Interface to PC Files and support for the local DBMS=STATA export.
Preserve local mode when SAS writes the DTA file to the same host. PCFS is a separate remote server mode; do not require PC Files Server or Office without a deployment change that needs it.
validation: Confirm the deployment component/version and documented local Stata export mode before the author preparation.

review_notes: Resource and software checks are now recorded in the evidence, requirements and software sections. Read-only checks include successful bounded COMP.FUNDA and CRSP.DSF reads, directory-existence-only SEC/LM checks, and timed-out proprietary probes retained as unverified; no author code was run.
The archive contains substantive 498-line SAS and 860-line Stata programs. The static parser reported no code IDs, but actual source contents establish code and both are full-pipeline entry points.
The supplied permnos.txt is a 637-firm identifier list, not an analysis dataset. The package does not include the prepared analysis tables or panel datasets.

Historical 2013–2014 acquisition/access statements do not establish current licenses, delivery, or prepared-data compatibility. All unresolved route outcomes remain undetermined; bounded probe timeouts are not evidence of absent products or entitlements.

The SAS-to-Stata generated handoff is coherent after configuration: SAS creates Programs/instrument_lag.dta and Stata reads instrument_lag from its Programs working directory. Keep this producer/consumer order when configuring paths. FF3F_abnormal_ret.dta is a separate Stata merge input with no supplied producer, and should not be conflated with SAS print.ret_volatility.

Stata input history follows supplied operations: lag 28 is used in robustness instruments, attention/news operations include leads through day +3, qea_10 uses the ±5-day event window, and business_d3 checks up to three prior returns. Validate source coverage against those operations; do not infer exact start dates from the source filters.

The SAS mn.ads4_JAR sharing extract appears before the later same-file mn.day1 producer. Schedule the distinct extract after the producer and weekend update, preserving its filter and keep-list; this is routine order preparation, not a main-panel failure.
The frozen local corpus probes for SEC and LM10-X established directory existence only. They do not establish SEC downloads_master access logs, the filing-date table, coverage or security crosswalks.

Appendix-only descriptions contextualize results but do not add unsupplied appendix analysis code as target scope. All supplied SAS table branches and Stata first-stage, IV, robustness, timing, liquidity and return branches remain in full_pipeline.

SAS capability inventory includes DATA steps, SQL, SORT, UNIVARIATE, MEANS and PROC EXPORT DBMS=STATA. SAS/ACCESS Interface to PC Files for Stata DTA export is unverified. Official SAS documentation distinguishes the supplied local DBMS=STATA mode from remote DBMS=PCFS; no Office or PC Files Server requirement is inferred for this workflow.
